_not: Harita 2: The Drowned Reach (docs/design/campaign/maps-2-3.md 3; yapım sırası 9.2 adım 1: iskelet, campaign-dev 2026-10-25). 83 düğüm, 6 bölge; konumlar ve kenarlar onaylı mockup public/mockups/maps-2-3/data.js > m2 (görsel 1672x941, assets/source/maps-2-3/drowned-reach-map-v2.png -> assets/campaign/drowned-reach-bg.webp). Düğüm id = "dr" + belgedeki numara (Harita 1 id'leriyle ve dalga / ölçek skipNodes listeleriyle çakışmasın). optional = cep (tek girişli çıkmaz dal, kesik yol); spoke = hub kolu (Saltmere'den çıkan yan durak: ileri yolu yok, rota / seçim noktası / K1 sayılmaz, yolu düz). level = düğüm seviyesi elle (ilk 3 düğüm L10, belge 8; diğerleri bölüm 2 rampası L11-20). Crossing (X) düğümleri şimdilik normal savaş (type battle, alt başlık Crossing); deniz yolu kilidi yok. Black Caravel (59) sabit elit cep (Open Water'dan); gezici kural M-K sonraki adım. continues = bu harita hangi haritanın devamı (başlangıçta kahraman seçimi yok; takım taşınır). Karşılaşmalar data/campaign/drowned-reach-encounters.json (yer tutucu: var olan moblar yeni adlarla), olaylar / hikâyeler / hazineler drowned-reach-events.json. Sayılar PROVİZYON.
title: THE DROWNED REACH
subtitle: Campaign Map II
blurb: From the Long Stair to the Throne of Brine: 83 stops, 6 regions, 48-53 stops per run.
intro: The ash has settled over Valdoria, but the Crown of Ash would not burn and would not break. In the vault beneath Castle Morvane you found a river chart and a single line in Morvane's hand: 'If I fall, carry it to the sea. The Tide must never wear it.' The river runs east, down the Long Stair, to the Drowned Reach.

complete.title: Two Crowns
complete.subtitle: To Be Continued
complete.text: The Drowned Queen is fallen and both halves of the Hearthcrown are in your hands. They pull north, toward the mountain. What was split must be mended, or ended.

regions.title: I · The Lower Valdren
regions.tagline: Down the Long Stair and the river gorge to Reedgate

regions.title: II · The Saltmarsh
regions.tagline: Through reed delta, salt pans and eel weirs to the river mouth

regions.title: III · Saltmere, the Harbor City
regions.tagline: Grey stone, grey sea and a cathedral sinking into the docks

regions.title: IV · The Wrecking Coast
regions.tagline: Cliffs, false lights and a graveyard of ships

regions.title: V · The Drowned Isles
regions.tagline: Sea lanes, storms and siren rocks among the isles

regions.title: VI · The Sunken Court
regions.tagline: Down the sunken stair to Maredh's drowned palace

nodes.name: The Long Stair
nodes.subtitle: Start · Battle
nodes.lore: The old stair road drops from the heights toward the river, and cultists in ash masks still follow the crown that passed this way.

nodes.name: Ferrymen's Rest
nodes.subtitle: Rest · Camp
nodes.lore: A ferrymen's shelter at the water's edge, its benches worn smooth by a hundred years of waiting.

nodes.name: The Rapids
nodes.subtitle: Battle · River Reavers
nodes.lore: White water roars through the gorge, and reavers wait on the rocks for boats that come down too fast.

nodes.name: Drowned Mill
nodes.subtitle: Battle · The Drowned
nodes.lore: The mill wheel still turns in the flood, and the drowned millers turn with it.

nodes.name: Barge Wreck
nodes.subtitle: Treasure · Guarded
nodes.lore: A grain barge lies broken on the shallows, its hold half full and something long moving under it.

nodes.name: Floodplain Farms
nodes.subtitle: Event
nodes.lore: The river has taken the lower fields, and the farmers who stayed are bailing out their homes by hand.

nodes.name: Tollhouse
nodes.subtitle: Elite · Reaver Chief
nodes.lore: Whoever holds the tollhouse holds the river. Today that is a reaver with an iron hook for a hand.

nodes.name: Hangman's Oak
nodes.subtitle: Battle · Wreck Ghouls
nodes.lore: The hanged are long gone from the oak, but the river keeps bringing back the drowned to sit beneath it.

nodes.name: Old Weir Road
nodes.subtitle: Battle · Weir Road Ambush
nodes.lore: The causeway along the old weir is the dry road east, and every bandit on the river knows it.

nodes.name: Widow's Ford
nodes.subtitle: Battle · Ford Lurkers
nodes.lore: The ford is waist deep and rising, and the widows say the water here has teeth.

nodes.name: Chapel of the Ford
nodes.subtitle: Treasure
nodes.lore: A little chapel stands above the ford, its door barred from the inside since the waters rose.

nodes.name: Reedgate
nodes.subtitle: Town · Rest, Recruits, Trade
nodes.lore: A reed-thatched village at the head of the marsh, where the river slows and the ferrymen gather.

hotspots.label: Notice Board
hotspots.note: Notices of flooded farms and missing boats. No one else here seeks to join a company.

nodes.name: Reedway
nodes.subtitle: Battle · Marsh Hexes
nodes.lore: A path of bound reeds winds into the marsh, and lights move out there that no one carries.

nodes.name: Salt Pans
nodes.subtitle: Battle · Salt Hags
nodes.lore: White crust covers the old salt pans, and the hags who work them call the tide in when strangers come.

nodes.name: Stilt Hamlet
nodes.subtitle: Event
nodes.lore: Houses stand on stilts above the water, and the eel-wives watch you from the walkways.

nodes.name: Eelwick
nodes.subtitle: Town · Rest, Recruits, Trade
nodes.lore: A town on stilts above the brackish water, smelling of smoke, salt and eel-oil.

hotspots.label: Notice Board
hotspots.note: Notices of flooded farms and missing boats. No one else here seeks to join a company.

nodes.name: The Great Weir
nodes.subtitle: Battle · Weir Guardians
nodes.lore: The great weir holds back the marsh, and the things that live in its pools do not like visitors.

nodes.name: Hag's Island
nodes.subtitle: Elite · Salt Hag Mother
nodes.lore: An island of black reeds where the eldest of the hags keeps her pots and her daughters.

nodes.name: Sunken Chapel
nodes.subtitle: Treasure · Guarded
nodes.lore: Only the bell tower of the chapel stands above the water. Something in rusted armour still keeps its vigil.

nodes.name: Heron Flats
nodes.subtitle: Battle · Flats Hunters
nodes.lore: Herons stalk the mud flats at low tide, and so does everything that eats herons.

nodes.name: The Drowned Causeway
nodes.subtitle: Battle · Causeway Dead
nodes.lore: An old stone causeway runs under a hand of water. The dead walk it as if it were still dry.

nodes.name: Smugglers' Reeds
nodes.subtitle: Event
nodes.lore: Narrow channels through tall reeds, where smugglers take a toll from anyone who uses their water.

nodes.name: Tidewatch Tower
nodes.subtitle: Rest · Camp
nodes.lore: A tower built to watch the tides, abandoned now, with a dry floor and a sound roof.

nodes.name: Brine Pools
nodes.subtitle: Battle · Brine Hags
nodes.lore: Pools of thick brine steam in the cold air, and the hags guard them like treasure.

nodes.name: Eel-Mother's Lair
nodes.subtitle: Treasure · Guarded
nodes.lore: The marsh folk will not fish this pool. They say the eel-mother sleeps on the bones of boats.

nodes.name: The Weir Mouth
nodes.subtitle: Boss · The Weir-Wyrm
nodes.lore: Where the marsh pours into the sea, the old weir has broken, and something vast has made the gap its home.

nodes.name: Saltmere Gate
nodes.subtitle: Battle · Order Quarantine
nodes.lore: The Order of St. Brann has closed the road to the harbour. No one passes the gate without their leave.

nodes.name: Saltmere
nodes.subtitle: City · Rest, Recruits, Trade
nodes.lore: The harbour city at the river mouth, grey stone and grey sea, its half-sunken cathedral leaning over the docks.

hotspots.label: Barracks
hotspots.note: The barracks are quiet. Every sword here has already sworn to someone.

nodes.name: Fishmarket
nodes.subtitle: Event
nodes.lore: The fishmarket hums with gossip, gulls and the smell of yesterday's catch.

nodes.name: Chandlers' Row
nodes.subtitle: Battle · Dock Rats
nodes.lore: Chandlers' Row sells rope, tar and lamp oil by day. By night it sells knives.

nodes.name: Guild Hall / Inquisition House
nodes.subtitle: Event
nodes.lore: The Guild Hall and the Inquisition House face each other across the square, and neither looks away.

nodes.name: Harbor Fort
nodes.subtitle: Elite · Guild Enforcer
nodes.lore: The harbour fort has changed hands twice this year. Its new masters do not want to give it back.

nodes.name: Sewer Outfall
nodes.subtitle: Battle · Sewer Dead
nodes.lore: The city's filth runs into the sea here, and what the sea sends back is worse.

nodes.name: The Drowned Cathedral
nodes.subtitle: Battle · Cathedral Dead
nodes.lore: The cathedral sank to its knees in a single night. Its congregation still kneels inside.

nodes.name: The Crypt Stair
nodes.subtitle: Treasure · Guarded
nodes.lore: A stair below the cathedral leads down into flooded crypts where the old bishops lie.

nodes.name: Chainwalk
nodes.subtitle: Battle · Corsairs
nodes.lore: Chains hang between the warehouses, and corsairs swing from them onto the decks below.

nodes.name: The Old Mole
nodes.subtitle: Battle · Wreckers
nodes.lore: The old mole shields the harbour from the sea. Wreckers use it to watch for easy ships.

nodes.name: Ferry Office
nodes.subtitle: Event
nodes.lore: The ferry office keeps the harbour's ledgers, and the clerk keeps the harbour's secrets.

nodes.name: Beacon Quay
nodes.subtitle: Rest · Camp
nodes.lore: A beacon fire burns at the end of the quay, and the harbour watch lets travellers rest beside it.

nodes.name: Quarantine Yard
nodes.subtitle: Battle · Quarantine Dead
nodes.lore: The sick were sent to the yard by the water, and the water came for them.

nodes.name: Gull Cliffs
nodes.subtitle: Battle · Cliff Hunters
nodes.lore: Gulls wheel over the cliffs, and below them the coast road clings to the rock.

nodes.name: Wreckers' Beacon
nodes.subtitle: Battle · Beacon Wreckers
nodes.lore: A false light burns on the headland to lure ships onto the rocks. Its keepers will not give it up.

nodes.name: Smugglers' Cave
nodes.subtitle: Treasure · Guarded
nodes.lore: A cave under the cliff, reached only at low tide, where smugglers keep what they cannot sell yet.

nodes.name: Bone Beach
nodes.subtitle: Battle · Bone Beach Dead
nodes.lore: The beach is white with ribs of ships and men alike.

nodes.name: Lantern Rock
nodes.subtitle: Event
nodes.lore: An old lighthouse stands dark on its rock, its lamp room open to the wind.

nodes.name: Widow's Watch
nodes.subtitle: Event
nodes.lore: From the widows' walk you can see a ship on the rocks and the wreckers already rowing out to it.

nodes.name: The Hanging Stair
nodes.subtitle: Battle · Stair Ambush
nodes.lore: Steps cut into the cliff face, with rope rails and a long drop to the sea.

nodes.name: Wreck of the Valdren Pride
nodes.subtitle: Battle · Boarders
nodes.lore: The Valdren Pride ran aground with her cargo still aboard. Corsairs got to her first.

nodes.name: Cliff Chapel
nodes.subtitle: Rest · Camp
nodes.lore: A chapel on the cliff top, its bell silent, its keeper glad of company.

nodes.name: The Wrecker's Hall
nodes.subtitle: Elite · The Wrecker-Captain
nodes.lore: The wreckers drink in a hall built from the timbers of the ships they have drowned.

nodes.name: Sea Cave Hoard
nodes.subtitle: Treasure · Guarded
nodes.lore: A sea cave glitters with things the tide has carried in, and with the shells of what guards them.

nodes.name: Saltspray Shrine
nodes.subtitle: Event
nodes.lore: A small shrine to the sea, crusted with salt, its offerings changed by the waves.

nodes.name: Gallows Point
nodes.subtitle: Battle · Gallows Dead
nodes.lore: Pirates were hanged on the point in the old days. Their gallows still stand, and so do they.

nodes.name: Fisher's Landing
nodes.subtitle: Town · Rest, Recruits, Trade
nodes.lore: A fishing village with a long jetty, where boats leave for the islands when the weather allows.

hotspots.label: Notice Board
hotspots.note: Notices of flooded farms and missing boats. No one else here seeks to join a company.

nodes.name: The Sound
nodes.subtitle: Crossing · Corsair Boarders
nodes.lore: The sound between the coast and the isles is narrow and busy, and not every ship on it flies honest colours.

nodes.name: Monk's Isle
nodes.subtitle: Event
nodes.lore: Monks of St. Brann keep a small house on the isle, and their bell carries over the water.

nodes.name: Siren Rocks
nodes.subtitle: Battle · Siren Song
nodes.lore: Rocks rise from the sea like broken teeth, and voices sing from them in the fog.

nodes.name: Gull Isle
nodes.subtitle: Battle · Isle Hounds
nodes.lore: Wild dogs rule the gull isle, and the corsairs who keep them there.

nodes.name: The Black Caravel
nodes.subtitle: Elite · Corsair Captain
nodes.lore: A black ship with black sails, and a captain who has never lost a boarding.

nodes.name: The Narrows
nodes.subtitle: Crossing · Narrows Boarders
nodes.lore: The narrows run between two isles, and the current pushes every ship toward the rocks.

nodes.name: Hermit's Skerry
nodes.subtitle: Rest · Camp
nodes.lore: A hermit's hut on a bare skerry, with a fire, a kettle and no questions.

nodes.name: Open Water
nodes.subtitle: Crossing · Deep Water
nodes.lore: Out here the water is black and deep, and the drowned rise to meet passing keels.

nodes.name: Pirate Cove
nodes.subtitle: Battle · Cove Corsairs
nodes.lore: A hidden cove full of stolen ships, and the corsairs who sail them.

nodes.name: Storm Strait
nodes.subtitle: Crossing · Storm Sirens
nodes.lore: The strait is never calm, and the sirens sing loudest in the storm.

nodes.name: Siren Queen's Rock
nodes.subtitle: Elite · The Siren Queen
nodes.lore: The tallest rock in the isles, where the siren queen sings ships to their graves.

nodes.name: Gallows Cove
nodes.subtitle: Boss · Admiral Vane
nodes.lore: The corsair fleet anchors in Gallows Cove, under the guns of its admiral's flagship.

nodes.name: Salt Monastery Vault
nodes.subtitle: Treasure
nodes.lore: Below the monks' house lies a vault where the order kept what the sea gave up.

nodes.name: Drowned Shoal
nodes.subtitle: Battle · Shoal Knights
nodes.lore: The water turns green over the shoal, and knights in rusted mail walk the sea floor.

nodes.name: The Sunken Stair
nodes.subtitle: Event
nodes.lore: A great stair runs down into the sea, and the sea does not cover it.

nodes.name: The Drowned Gate
nodes.subtitle: Battle · Gate Guard
nodes.lore: The gate of the sunken court stands open, guarded by knights who swore their oath under water.

nodes.name: Hall of Tides
nodes.subtitle: Battle · Tide Callers
nodes.lore: A vaulted hall where the tide rises and falls, and with every tide the dead rise too.

nodes.name: The Salt Garden
nodes.subtitle: Treasure · Guarded
nodes.lore: A garden of salt flowers and coral, tended by pale maidens who do not breathe.

nodes.name: Courtiers' Walk
nodes.subtitle: Battle · Courtiers
nodes.lore: The drowned court still walks its gallery, bowing to a throne it cannot see.

nodes.name: The Bishop's Chapel
nodes.subtitle: Elite · The Salt Bishop
nodes.lore: The court's chapel, where the salt bishop preaches to the drowned.

nodes.name: Flooded Library
nodes.subtitle: Event · Rest
nodes.lore: Shelves of swollen books, and among them, dry in a sealed case, the court's own history.

nodes.name: Kennels of the Deep
nodes.subtitle: Battle · Kennel Beasts
nodes.lore: The court's hounds were drowned with their masters. They are still hungry.

nodes.name: Armory of Maredh
nodes.subtitle: Treasure · Guarded
nodes.lore: The armory of Maredh, where the court's champions left their weapons to rust.

nodes.name: The Long Gallery
nodes.subtitle: Battle · Gallery Guard
nodes.lore: A long gallery of portraits, every face in them drowned.

nodes.name: The Champion's Stair
nodes.subtitle: Elite · The Drowned Champion
nodes.lore: The champion of the court guards the stair to the throne, as he did in life.

nodes.name: Last Camp
nodes.subtitle: Rest · Camp
nodes.lore: A dry chamber in the drowned palace, the last quiet place before the throne.

nodes.name: Antechamber
nodes.subtitle: Battle · The Queen's Guard
nodes.lore: The antechamber of the throne, where the whole court waits for its queen.

nodes.name: Throne of Brine
nodes.subtitle: Final Boss · The Drowned Queen
nodes.lore: On a throne of brine sits the Drowned Queen, and on her head the Crown of Salt.

nodes.name: Two Crowns
nodes.subtitle: Event
nodes.lore: Two halves of one crown, and the long road north.
